verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own marketing says it identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files, which covers the diarization half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows those speakers are matched to real participant names rather than generic labels, and there is no independent or hands-on check of attribution accuracy. The attendee-email filter in the API is a different feature and earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented real-name speaker matching, evidence of attribution accuracy, independent/hands-on corroboration, in-depth docs on speaker labeling in transcripts

support.subject: As a product manager, the transcript attributes words to the right named speakers (diarization plus real name matching), not just "Speaker 1/2"

citations.quote: Fireflies identifies different speakers in meetings and audio files.
